instructions.question: Does the tweet carry an upbeat evaluation, a critical or unhappy one, or no evaluation at all?
instructions.rule: Look for the author's evaluative wording. Upbeat words or emoticons (good, best, fun, love, :), <3) with no complaint make it positive. Critical judgments, setbacks, disappointment (:(, bummed), annoyance or sarcastic attacks make it negative. Neutral: logistics, bare invitations, event hype without praise words ('don't miss', 'place to be', 'retweet if'), questions, stats, jokes, tactical sports second-guessing, laughed-off hassles, and third-person headlines (debates, arrests, markets) unless they report violence or deaths (negative) or clear achievements (positive).

neutral.what: No evaluation: logistics, ads, invitations, questions, stats, headlines, jokes, tactical sports talk, laughed-off hassles.
examples: So .... Who's up for seeing Ant-Man with me on Saturday? 2:30pm showing. Let me know!
David Price should not have been pitching in the 8th. They can't get a 6-outs from the bullpen? Yankees - Jays
I could be going to digi tomorrow but I thought I was supposed to be seeing the girls but they cancelled lmao
neutral.cues: who's going, don't miss, should have started, slams, reports, scores, lmao
neutral.not_for: Praise or warmth makes it positive; an insult, harsh judgment, :( or real frustration makes it negative.

positive.what: Upbeat feeling or praise: excitement, affection, hope for a team, warm sales pitches, fun plans, achievements.
examples: Jason Aldean&Kenny Chesney tickets for sale. Concert is the 29th. Good seats for a really good price. Text me asap for more info!!
We always mess up when we get the chance to go up the table when Atleti or Barca mess up. PLEASE WIN TOMORROW :) @user
positive.cues: good, best, fun, can't wait, love, see you there, :), <3, Happy [day]
positive.not_for: Event ads, 'who's going?' and dry score lines are neutral.

negative.what: Criticism, contempt, complaints, disappointment, setbacks, sarcastic attacks, sadness, or news of violence or deaths.
examples: "Caitlyn Jenner may not be ""down"" with gay marriage, but she should really understand that people are gonna see that as hypocritical."
I'm slightly bummed the Foo Fighters are playing Friday night of ACL rather than Sunday. I'm pretty much not gonna care the other 2 days.
A Thursday night with no Waterloo road on! #boring
negative.cues: hypocritical, bitter, racist, you just hate, bummed, dang it, :(, argh, #boring, killed
negative.not_for: Strong words used in excitement are positive.
